title: Your First Weekend at Case Western Reserve University, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your first days at CWRU with this sequence of essential campus stops, from orientation traditions to local University Circle landmarks.

cards.title: Kick Off Discover Week
cards.subtitle: Orientation Headquarters
cards.notes: Check in at Wolstein Hall to receive your orientation materials and meet your orientation leaders before the mandatory sessions begin.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for new student orientation check-in and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Discover Week is the mandatory orientation program for new students, with the orientation office located in Wolstein Hall.
cards.source_title: Discover Week — Your CWRU Orientation | Orientation and New Student Transitions
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours for orientation check-in; mandatory for all new first-year students.

cards.title: Saturday Morning Brunch
cards.subtitle: South Side Dining
cards.notes: Head to the South Residential Village for a weekend brunch. It is a primary meeting spot for students living on the south side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A major dining hall serving the South Residential Village with weekend meal service.
cards.evidence_claim: Fribley Commons is one of the two main dining halls and offers weekend hours for students.
cards.access_notes: Open for brunch and dinner on weekends; requires a meal swipe or CaseCash.

cards.title: Climb the Elephant Stairs
cards.subtitle: South Village Connection
cards.notes: Walk the oversized steps connecting Murray Hill Road to Carlton Road. It is a rite of passage for students living in the South Village.
cards.short_summary: A massive covered staircase known for its deep treads that require multiple steps per stair.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elephant Stairs connect the lower and upper levels of the South Residential Village and are a well-known campus curiosity.
cards.source_title: Myths, Mysteries and Curiosities | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor staircase connecting residential areas.

cards.title: Explore 'The Tink'
cards.subtitle: Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Visit the student center to find the bookstore, various food options, and student organization offices in a modern, glass-walled space.
cards.short_summary: The central university center housing student services, dining, and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Tinkham Veale University Center serves as a hub for student activities, dining, and resources like the Women's Center and LGBTQ+ Center.
cards.access_notes: Open daily with extended hours; accessible to all students with a CWRU ID.

cards.title: Afternoon at the Museum
cards.subtitle: World-Class Art Next Door
cards.notes: Walk across the street to explore one of the nation's top art museums. Admission to the permanent collection is always free.
cards.short_summary: A world-renowned art museum located directly adjacent to the CWRU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cleveland Museum of Art is free to the public and is a primary cultural attraction for CWRU students.
cards.source_title: Free Access Program | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Sunday; closed Mondays. General admission is free.

cards.title: Relax by Wade Lagoon
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Garden
cards.notes: Take a break at the scenic lagoon in front of the art museum. It is a popular spot for photos and quiet study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A picturesque lagoon and park area located between the campus and the Cleveland Museum of Art.
cards.evidence_claim: Wade Lagoon and the surrounding Fine Arts Garden are public park spaces frequently used by the CWRU community.
cards.source_title: Wade Lagoon and the City Beautiful Movement | Cleveland Museum of Art

cards.title: Dinner at The Jolly
cards.subtitle: Campus Grill and Diner
cards.notes: Grab a burger or a milkshake at this on-campus eatery. It is a favorite for casual meals and accepts meal swipes for certain items.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus restaurant and bar known for its burgers and student-friendly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jolly Scholar is an on-campus dining location that accepts meal swipes and CaseCash.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; kitchen typically closes at 10:00 PM. Under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: Sunday Activities Fair
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Campus
cards.notes: Visit the KSL Oval during orientation to find student organization tables and learn how to get involved on campus.
cards.short_summary: The large green space in front of the main library, used for major campus events and fairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Activities Fair is held on the Kelvin Smith Library Oval during orientation week.
cards.source_title: Events and Programming | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; fair times vary by orientation schedule.

cards.title: Walk to Little Italy
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road Corridor
cards.notes: Stroll down Mayfield Road to Cleveland's historic Little Italy for a cannoli at Presti's or dinner at a local trattoria.
cards.short_summary: A historic neighborhood adjacent to campus famous for its Italian bakeries and restaurants.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Italy is a short walk from the first-year residence halls and is a recommended off-campus destination for new students.
cards.source_title: Your first trip off campus: Where to go | Orientation and New Student Transitions
cards.access_notes: Public neighborhood; most businesses open daily until late evening.

cards.title: Late Night Ice Cream
cards.subtitle: Uptown Treat
cards.notes: End your weekend with a scoop of locally-made ice cream at the Uptown shop. It is a staple for CWRU students and campus tours.
cards.short_summary: A popular local ice cream shop located in the Uptown district bordering campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mitchell's Ice Cream is a default ending to campus tours and a popular student hangout in the Uptown area.
cards.source_title: Your first trip off campus: Where to go | Orientation and New Student Transitions
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM on weekends.
